about: News sources for the 40 competition assets (UKIC). Researched and fetched on 2026-10-02 from a Mac; re-check on the Windows machine with `npm run check-feeds`. See docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md for how to use this file. Tiers: 1 = official (company, regulator, court), 2 = reputable aggregator, 3 = unconfirmed (never trade on it alone). ua: browser (default) | feedreader (site only answers feed readers) | contact (SEC/BLS require a User-Agent with a contact email: set FEED_CONTACT).

assets.name: NVIDIA
assets.expect: Earnings, buybacks, partner deals (its supplier deals move LITE and GLW). Next results ~18-19 Nov (unconfirmed).

assets.name: AMD
assets.expect: Acquisitions and AI partnerships. Next results ~3-4 Nov (unconfirmed).

assets.name: Intel

assets.name: iShares $ Treasury Bond 20+yr UCITS ETF USD (Acc)

alpaca.about: Main live news feed (Benzinga). Needs a free Alpaca account: set ALPACA_KEY_ID and ALPACA_SECRET_KEY, then `npm run check-feeds` tests both the REST endpoint and the live stream.
